notes.title: Extended Update
notes.content:
[b]Due to the not small number of negative reviews, in the next couple of days there will be an update in which the existing bugs will be fixed. 

It will also be added: the use of medicines and food to accelerate the speed. Most of the players could not find access to the locked doors and rooms, so there will be hints.

The traps will be more and they will be more diverse.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34086298/1d59cac0c52cea2e6deaab9b3f9b7810a8ccdcfe.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34086298/9609f73b6e0b607682deb0223bf6106f05878911.png[/img]

notes.title: Update (Release)
notes.content:
[list][*]Added achievements (10).
[*]Increased game location.
[*]Changed the location of the secret room.
[*]Increased the duration of the flashlight.
[*]Jump range increased.
[*]The amount of disk space required is reduced from 5 GB to 3 GB.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34086298/2c4c097b9123c6d62f5e112b32ac24a90de5ebd8.jpg[/img]
